executionStatement: This fixture is human-authored static teaching data. It is not model output or a model run.

modelSeam.purpose: Show a bounded synthetic context draft contract and a no-forecast rejection without calling a model.

reviewerDecision.nextStep: Check the source receipt, synthetic-data label, and factual fields before a person writes any context brief.
reviewerDecision.mustNotDo: Do not forecast, explain a labour-market change, recommend hiring, set pay, give visa advice, publish, or act externally.

boundaryNotes: Every value is synthetic teaching data and not an ABS observation or statistic.
A period-to-period difference is context only; it is not a trend claim, forecast, or decision.

reviewerDecision.nextStep: Return to the source-receipt question or seek a separately authorised, human-owned process for any consequential decision.
reviewerDecision.mustNotDo: Do not turn the context packet into a forecast, staffing plan, pay decision, visa advice, publication, or external action.

structuredResponse.rejectionMessage: A labour-market forecast is outside this source-receipt and context-only teaching workflow.
boundaryNotes: The local series is synthetic and cannot support a labour-market forecast.
Any consequential workforce decision stays with a separately authorised human process.
